{{Short description|German politician}}
[[File:2017-03-23 Maja Lasić by Sandro Halank–1.jpg|thumb|right]]
'''Maja Lasić''' (born 1979, [[Mostar]]) is a Yugoslavia-born German politician. She is an elected member of the [[Abgeordnetenhaus of Berlin]], the parliament of the city and state of [[Berlin]].<ref name="abgeord">{{cite web |title=Dr. Maja Lasić, SPD |url=https://www.parlament-berlin.de/de/Abgeordnete/Lasic-Maja |publisher=Abgeordnetenhaus Berlin |accessdate=28 August 2019}}</ref>

Lasić was born in 1979 in [[Mostar]] in former [[Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia |Yugoslavia]], now [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], and moved to Germany as a refugee aged 14. After two months in a special "welcome class" she joined mainstream high school classes, and  passed her [[Abitur]] in 1998. She studied biology at the [[University of Münster]] and gained a Ph.D. in biochemistry (2008) from the [[University of Stuttgart]]. She worked for [[Procter & Gamble]] from 2007 to 2009 but then moved to become first a fellow and then a manager with [[Teach First Deutschland]].<ref name=abgeord /><ref name="leben">{{cite web |title=Mein Leben |url=http://maja-lasic.de/mein-leben-2/ |publisher=Maja Lasic |accessdate=28 August 2019}}</ref> She joined the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|SPD]] in 2010 and was elected to the [[Abgeordnetenhaus of Berlin]] in 2016, representing the "{{ill|Central 7|de|Wahlkreis Mitte 7}}" constituency which is centred on [[Wedding (Berlin)|Wedding]].<ref name=abgeord /><ref name="wahlkreis">{{cite web |title=Mein Wahlkreis |url=http://maja-lasic.de/ |publisher=Maja Lasić |accessdate=28 August 2019}}</ref>
